player_prompt.intro:
Yu pilai Tower of Hanoi wantaim {num_disks} disks.
Yu mas muvim disks from tower A long tower C.
Long muvim wanpela disk, yu typim tower bilong bikim na tower bilong go (olsem, '[A C]').
Nogat, yu no ken muvim disk i no stap antap, na disk bilong bikpela no ken go antap long disk bilong liklik.
Long taim bilong yu, yu givim wanpela muv.
